I took the plate to be a standard dinner plate of about 26 cm. In the photo it spans roughly 585 px, so about 22 px per cm.

**Spring roll:** It measures about 270 px long, roughly 12 cm, and about 120 px wide, roughly 5 cm. That seems too wide, so I read the width as about 3.5–4 cm because of the viewing angle. This works out to a cylinder of about 12 cm × 3.5 cm diameter, or roughly 115 cm³. A fresh roll is not dense, so I estimated about 100 g.

**French fries:** There are 6 fries, each about 6 cm × 0.8 cm × 0.8 cm, so about 3 cm³ each. At roughly 0.6 g/cm³ that is 2–3 g apiece, or about 15 g in total. Allowing for some thicker pieces, I settled on 18 g.

No sauce is visible.
